Emma (AE): Heads up team, HelixHealth is ready to sign the POC but procurement is insisting on a wet-ink original for the Order Form. They're blocking kickoff until we comply.

Kai (Procurement): Do they categorically refuse e-sign? Their note says Policy 12.4 requires originals for vendors >$100k. POC is < $100k but compliance is picky. Could we accept a notarized scanned copy with an original mailed later?

Emma (AE): They said notarized scan is acceptable if the original is ‘on file’. PO number is PO-88932. Jordan, any legal concerns with a hybrid workflow?

Jordan (Legal): Hybrid is workable. Suggest we: (1) send DocuSign for our countersignature immediately so we have an executed record, (2) accept notarized scanned copy for acceptance/processing, and (3) require the customer to mail the original within 10 business days. Add an attestation clause to the Order Form: 

``
Scanned copies (including notarized scans) of manually executed Order Forms shall be deemed originals for purposes of contract formation and invoicing.
``

Also add DPA/Exhibit reference: "Data processing governed by DPA in Exhibit C." I can attach a one-line addendum to the envelope.

Natalie (Finance): Accounting needs the PO number and invoice remittance address. If we receive a notarized scan plus PO-88932, Finance can issue the invoice and process Net30. If they ask for Net45 that'll need approval.

Emma (AE): I've uploaded the latest Order Form: https://secure.redwood.company/attachments/helix-poc-orderform-v2.pdf and the SOC2 link: https://secure.redwood.company/soc2/helix-2025-type2?token=REDACTED (expires in 30 days).

Kai (Procurement): Please mail the original to: HelixHealth Corp, Attn: Procurement - Contracts, PO Box 4128, Cambridge, MA 02139. Include a cover letter with PO-88932. We'll accept notarized scan in the interim if original arrives within 10 business days.

DocuSignBot: Envelope env_0b7c created for HelixHealth - recipients: HelixHealth Procurement, Emma (AE), Jordan (Legal). Status: awaiting signatures.

Jordan (Legal): Two quick asks: add the attestation to the Order Form footer; include a DPA reference line; and add a DocuSign attachment noting the original-wet-ink-handoff timeline. I can draft the envelope text.

Emma (AE): I'll overnight the wet-ink original today and update tracking here. I'll attach the notarized scan when they send it back. Will ping @Jordan and @Natalie when the scan arrives. Thanks all :thumbsup:
